**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

- **§ 12.3** expressly preserves our freedom to engage any supplier and records that Customer has made **no exclusivity, non-compete, MFN, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment** — this meets the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer).
- A full-text sweep for "exclusiv"/sole-supplier/requirements language surfaced only benign or favourable uses: the non-exclusive licence grant (§ 13.1), Vendor's Deliverable ownership (§ 14.2), non-exclusive remedy language (§§ 19.4, 21.4, 30.2), and exclusive jurisdiction (§§ 28.1–28.2).
- **§ 7.2** (disclose-and-match before engaging another provider) and **§ 2.1** (three-year take-or-pay minimum) create practical friction but are not exclusive-dealing covenants; they are the same commercial terms handled under the MFN and minimum-commitment rules, so they are noted here rather than double-flagged.
